promo_options.hook: Lady Ashbourne coldly condemns Catherine: 'She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road.'
promo_options.cliffhanger: Catherine is completely broken and humiliated, prostrating herself on the floor before Alexander and Juliana as the scene cuts to black.
promo_options.reasoning: This clip packs an intense revenge arc, showing the fallen villainess forced to accept the ultimate degradation of becoming a scullery maid under her rival.
